newsitem.title: USA: Benchmark Electronics seeks share issue.
newsitem.headline: Benchmark Electronics seeks share issue.

text.p: Benchmark Electronics Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday for up to 1.25 million common shares.
Of the total, the company said it would sell up to 1.0 million shares while certain shareholders would offer up to 250,000 additional shares.
It said net proceeds would be used to pay about $14.5 million of debt outstanding under a revolving credit facility and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through Stephens & Co, J.C. Bradford & Co and Wheat First Butcher Singer. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 187,500 additional shares.
